chunks: The arrogant will say: 'All of us are in it. Surely God has judged between the creatures.'

key_terms.إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَا: All of us are in it (Hell)
key_terms.الَّذِينَ اسْتَكْبَرُوا: The arrogant / those who were haughty

ai.seo_question: What do the arrogant say when they realize everyone is in Hell?
ai.summary: In the commentary of Al-Tabarsi and other Shia exegetes, this verse highlights the moment of finality where the arrogant, having exhausted all excuses, admit that Allah’s judgment is absolute and irreversible. It underscores the concept of 'Hukm' (judgment) as a completed divine decree, contrasting the fate of the proud with the humility of the believers, thereby serving as a warning against spiritual arrogance in this life.
